race.comment: MASAKARI (2) returns after a break of four-and-a-half months having looked close to a win prior to the spell with four consecutive minor placings. He should be an improver this time around and sets up nicely from the low gate. PRINCESS ZOUSAIN (10) is a Zousain filly on debut for the Hayes yard who has jumped out fairly well, have to respect the top yard here. GALAGACISCO (1) raced below his best last time when sixth over 1300m at Wangaratta, beaten 5.5 lengths. Fitter again and slightly drier surface now can see him improve. ESTIVAL (7) encouraging first-up run when third at this track over 1100m on June 27. Can feature.
